app.name: Aegis
app.previewNotice: LAN preview over HTTP: no encrypted connection and no push notifications. For the first synthetic-data test only.
app.pilotNotice: Household pilot over HTTPS on the home network. Push notifications are not configured. Check the current backup state on the Status page.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Sign in with your personal login. Both members see the same documents and tasks.

today.title: Today
today.empty: Nothing for today. New tasks come from documents or the task list.
today.calendarNotConnected: No calendar is connected. Appointments appear here only after a verified calendar integration; nothing is simulated.
today.onDemand: This view is computed from stored tasks every time you open it.

documents.title: Documents
documents.uploadHint: PDF only, up to 50 MB. Saved means durably stored on the server. Archival in Paperless runs separately afterwards.
documents.uploaded: “{{title}}” has been stored durably. Archival is in progress.
documents.duplicate: This file already existed: “{{title}}”. No duplicate was created.
documents.duplicateTrashed: This file is already in the trash: “{{title}}”. Open the trash to restore it.
documents.searchHint: Content search uses the archive full text once a document is archived.
documents.contentSearchUnavailable: The archive is unreachable right now: only title matches are shown and the list may be incomplete.
documents.empty: No documents yet. Upload the first PDF.
documents.originalUnavailable: The original cannot be retrieved right now.
documents.noLinkedTasks: No task for this document yet.
documents.newTask: Create a task from this document
documents.unsortedHint: New uploads stay here until they are filed into a folder.
documents.filterLogic: Several values in one group count as OR, different groups as AND.
documents.notContentIndexed: {{count}} matching documents are not archived yet and therefore not searchable by content.
documents.notContentIndexed_one: One matching document is not archived yet and therefore not searchable by content.
documents.noResultsFiltered: No results for the active filters.
documents.suggestionHint: Suggestions come from automatic classification and only take effect once you accept them.
documents.confidenceHint: The model score is the model's own estimate, not a verified guarantee.
documents.inheritedFromFolder: Inherited from the folder; it changes when the document moves.

subjects.hint: The assignment is search metadata. It does not restrict who can see the document.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.dueHint: The due date is the real deadline. The planned date is only your plan and never moves the deadline.
tasks.conflict: Someone else changed this task in the meantime. The current version has been reloaded; please review it and repeat your change.

cancellation.title: {{name}} - Review cancellation
cancellation.completionHint: Completing this review does not record that the contract was cancelled. Change the contract status separately after taking action.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.nameRequired: Please enter a name for the contract.
contracts.empty: No contracts yet. Create the first one and enter what the document states.
contracts.stale: Someone else changed this contract in the meantime. The current version has been reloaded; please review it and repeat your decision.

deadline.title: Cancellation deadline
deadline.none: No cancellation deadline can be calculated yet
deadline.contractualHint: This is the contractual deadline. Planned work and reminders are separate and never move it.
deadline.insufficient: No cancellation deadline can be calculated.
deadline.insufficientHint: Aegis calculates only from confirmed rules and never estimates a deadline.
deadline.insufficientUnspecified: The confirmed statements do not establish a deadline.
deadline.contradicting: Confirmed statements contradict each other and need a decision first: {{types}}

basis.STATED_DEADLINE: A document states this date itself.
basis.NOTICE_PERIOD_BEFORE_END: Calculated as the contract end on {{end}} minus the confirmed notice period.

deadline.basisUnknown: Calculated from the confirmed statements listed below.

conflicts.title: Conflicts
conflicts.hint: Aegis reports contradictions and does not choose between them. As long as a conflict stands, no value counts as effective for those days.

kind.CONFIRMED_AGAINST_CONFIRMED: Two confirmed statements about {{type}} describe the same day differently.
kind.EXTRACTED_AGAINST_CONFIRMED: A proposal about {{type}} contradicts what the household confirmed.

facts.title: Statements
facts.empty: Nothing recorded about this contract yet.

fact.newLabel: Enter a statement about the contract
fact.enterHint: What you enter counts as confirmed, because a member states it.
fact.validityHint: Leave both empty when the statement applies for the whole contract. A statement that starts later amends the contract instead of replacing the earlier value.
fact.sourceRequiredForPage: A page or a quote can only be stored together with the document it was read in.
fact.provenanceHint: Only give a page or a quote when the document really states it there.
fact.supersededHint: Kept as history: this is the value a member saw when they decided.
fact.correctHint: The corrected statement stays readable as history; the new value counts as confirmed.

manage.title: Contract
manage.statusHint: The status records what the household did with the contract. It does not change any statement or deadline.

notices.title: Notices

kind.DOCUMENT_ARCHIVED: “{{title}}” has been archived and is searchable.
kind.DOCUMENT_ARCHIVAL_FAILED: Archival of “{{title}}” failed ({{code}}). The original remains stored.

notices.inAppOnly: Notices are shown here in the app only. Phone push is not set up.

review.title: Review inbox
review.intro: One shared place for processing failures, uncertain classifications and contract statements. Opening or dismissing a card does not change its source; source actions still enforce their own rules.
review.emptyHistory: No items in this history view.

reason.ARCHIVAL_FAILED: The retained original can be submitted again.
reason.ANALYSIS_FAILED: The document is safe; only the optional analysis failed.
reason.UNCERTAIN_CLASSIFICATION: Confirm or reject each proposal on the document.
reason.UNCONFIRMED_FACT: It remains ineffective until a member confirms or corrects it.
reason.CONFLICTING_FACTS: Aegis will not choose between contradictory sources.

status.title: Status
status.backupWarning: The external backup is unavailable or out of date. Check the backup status below.

ai.title: AI execution
ai.configured: An AI provider is set up on the server. Every run is limited by time, cost, tool calls and retries.
ai.notConfigured: No AI provider is set up. Upload, search and tasks work without AI.
ai.memberNotAllowed: Without an API key, AI uses a personal Claude subscription that is not enabled for your account. Upload, search and tasks work as usual.
ai.spentToday: Spent today: {{spent}} of the {{limit}} daily limit
ai.budgetLine: up to {{cost}} per run, {{attempts}} attempts, {{seconds}} s per attempt
ai.runLine: {{date}} · attempt {{attempt}} of {{maxAttempts}} · {{cost}} of {{limit}} · model calls: {{calls}}, tool calls: {{tools}}
ai.cancelPending: Cancellation requested: the run stops at its next checkpoint and applies no result.

failure.TOOL_DENIED: Asked for tools that are not allowed

trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Deleted documents, tasks and contracts end up here and stay restorable at least until the date shown. Nothing is deleted permanently.
trash.banner: In the trash – deleted by {{name}} on {{date}}
trash.moved: Moved to the trash. You can restore it at any time.
trash.confirm: It disappears from all lists and from search. You can restore it from the trash; nothing is deleted permanently.
trash.changedMeanwhile: This was changed in the meantime. The view is up to date again – please check it once more.
trash.documentHint: The original is kept, and so are tasks and contracts that refer to the document.
trash.contractHint: All statements are kept. While the contract is in the trash, it gets no cancellation reminder.

settings.title: Settings
settings.localeSaved: The language is saved for your account.

facets.SUBJECT: Concerns
facets.hintORGANIZATION: Sender or provider, for example Telekom.
facets.hintTOPIC: What it is about, for example internet.

labels.title: Labels
labels.intro: Labels are shared by the household. Renaming, merging and retiring keep every assignment; no document is ever deleted.
labels.empty: No own labels in this group yet.
labels.name: Name
labels.aliasesHint: One spelling per line. The same organization is then found under other names too.
labels.retireHint: Existing assignments stay and remain searchable; new ones are no longer possible.
labels.mergeHint: Every assignment and folder rule moves to the target; the old name is kept as a spelling.
labels.convertHint: A tag can become an organization or a topic.
labels.deleteHint: Only possible while no document and no folder uses the label.

folders.title: Folders
folders.intro: Folders are the shared filing structure. Every document sits in exactly one folder or in Unsorted.
folders.name: Name
folders.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{name}}”? Documents and subfolders move one level up. Labels that came only from this folder stay on the documents. Documents are never deleted.
folders.deleted: “{{name}}” deleted: {{documents}} documents and {{folders}} subfolders moved, {{labels}} labels kept.
folders.impliedHint: Documents in this folder and its subfolders inherit these labels automatically, so “House” is maintained in one place only.
folders.affects: Affects {{count}} documents in this folder and its subfolders.
folders.starterHint: Creates House / Invoices / Internet, Water and House / Insurance with matching labels. Everything stays editable.

analysis.title: Automatic classification

state.NOT_REQUESTED: This document has not been classified automatically yet.
state.WAITING_FOR_ARCHIVE: Classification starts as soon as the archive has recognized the text.
state.CLASSIFIED: Classified. You can change automatically set values at any time.
state.NEEDS_REVIEW: Classified. Some suggestions are waiting for your review.
state.FAILED: Classification failed. The document itself is saved and archived.
state.UNAVAILABLE: AI was not available. The document itself is saved.

analysis.completed: Last classified on {{date}} with {{model}}, started by {{name}}.

flag.POOR_OCR: The recognized text is hard to read. Nothing was applied automatically.
flag.NO_TEXT: No text was recognized in the document. Nothing was applied automatically.
flag.CONFLICTING_INFORMATION: The document contradicts itself. Nothing was applied automatically.
flag.EMBEDDED_INSTRUCTIONS: The document contains instructions aimed at an AI. They were ignored; nothing was applied automatically.
flag.MULTIPLE_DOCUMENTS: The file seems to contain several documents. Nothing was applied automatically.

date.CONFLICTING: Several conflicting document dates – not used.
date.UNVERIFIED: The reported date could not be confirmed in the text – not used.

analysis.newNames: New names that are not in the vocabulary yet:
analysis.filename: File name for downloads and exports
analysis.filenameHint: The id at the end and the extension are always added. The original file stays unchanged.
analysis.costHint: Uses the shared daily AI budget.
analysis.policyHint: Only what the text evidences and the vocabulary already knows is applied. Everything else stays a suggestion. Your decisions are not overwritten by later runs.
analysis.selectionLimit: At most {{max}} documents can be classified at once.
analysis.bulkPartly: Classification started for {{count}} documents, {{skipped}} skipped (not archived, already in progress or AI unavailable).
analysis.bulkPartly_one: Classification started for {{count}} document, {{skipped}} skipped (not archived, already in progress or AI unavailable).

placement.title: Folder suggestion
placement.namesHint: Separate levels with /. Leave empty to file the document directly in the selected folder.
placement.addsNothing: This folder adds no further labels.
placement.alsoForOthers: Also move {{count}} other documents with the same suggestion
placement.alsoForOthers_one: Also move {{count}} other document with the same suggestion
placement.rejected: Suggestion rejected. This folder will not be suggested for this document again.
placement.automatic: Aegis filed this document into this folder automatically.
placement.automaticWithConfidence: Aegis filed this document automatically (the model's own estimate: {{value}}).
placement.reverted: The document is back in Unsorted.
placement.hint: Aegis never creates folders on its own. You can change the names and the parent folder first.

share.title: Save shared files
share.hint: Shared files wait on this phone until the server confirms that they are stored durably. If the upload is interrupted, nothing is lost: try again.
share.discardAllConfirm: Discard {{count}} shared files without saving them? The originals stay in the app you shared from.
share.discardAllConfirm_one: Discard the shared file without saving it? The original stays in the app you shared from.
share.done: {{count}} files are stored durably. Archival runs in the background.
share.done_one: The file is stored durably. Archival runs in the background.
share.returnHint: Use your phone's back button to return to the app you shared from.
share.duplicateOf: Already in Aegis as “{{title}}”. No duplicate was created.
share.empty: No shared files are waiting to be saved.
share.nothingReceived: No PDF file was received. Aegis accepts PDF files only.
share.browserDroppedFiles: Known Chrome bug: Chrome 153 on Android hands installed web apps no files, only the title. Until Chrome is updated, upload the file on the Documents page.
share.receiveFailed: The shared file could not be received. Please share it again.
share.notReady: Aegis was not ready to receive the file. It is ready now: please share the file again.
share.unsupported: This browser cannot keep shared files. Please upload the file on the Documents page.
share.pending: {{count}} shared files are waiting to be saved.
share.pending_one: A shared file is waiting to be saved.
share.loginFirst: Sign in to save the files you shared. They stay on this phone until then.
